article.title: CISA to federal agencies: Remediate exploited Ivanti Connect Secure vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527)
article.summary: CISA added two new Ivanti Connect Secure vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on Friday, after Ivanti updated an earlier security advisory with details about the flaws. article.title: Tech Firms Dismantle Botnet That Turned 1.3M TV Boxes Into Proxies
article.summary: Google said today it worked with industry partners to dismantle a botnet made up of more than 1.3 million Android TV set-top boxes that ship with malicious software which secretly rents the user's Internet connection out to strangers and conducts advertising fraud. Experts involved in the takedown say the action is likely to sever the botnet's access to more than 10 million additional compromised systems, including other Internet of Things (IoT) products such as Android-based healthcare devices and karaoke machines.

items.relevance_reason: Google cùng các đối tác công nghệ đã triệt phá mạng lưới botnet hơn 1,3 triệu thiết bị Android TV Box bị cài mã độc ngầm.

article.title: Critical Langflow Flaws Could Let Unauthenticated Attackers Run Code on Servers
article.summary: Two critical flaws in Langflow could let a remote attacker with no account bypass authentication or run arbitrary code, IBM said last week. Langflow is an open-source tool for building AI agents and workflows, and its vulnerability reports go to IBM.
